content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The summary ends with the FAD finding that Complainant \"failed to prove\" discrimination, but it shows no analysis linking the evidence (OPR report, nonselection facts, Division Chief conversation) to that conclusion, including for the two nonselection claims, where no selection reasons appear."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Some sources are identified (HRM notices, the OPR Bluebook Report of 9 interviews, Complainant's own statements, Division Chief's contrary account), but the witnesses' denials are summarized without individual attribution, and the existence of the Administrator's Audit Report and the travel vouchers is only asserted by Complainant."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Many events are dated (June 2017–June 2018, April 11 and May 24, 2018, October 30, 2018 OPR report), but the sequence is inconsistent or unclear (a September 2017 nonselection, an October 2017 resignation, the transfer date of June 1 versus September 2018, and a misplaced JOA/untimely-contact fragment mid-narrative)."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who made the FAD, what standard was applied, or whether Complainant's unobtained documents and 15 named witnesses were considered, and it does not say how the OPR report and the Division Chief's account were weighed."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"With the conclusion unsupported by any stated reasoning, no management explanations for the nonselections, and unresolved date conflicts, an independent reviewer could not assess from this record alone whether the FAD is supported."}}}
